 Mr. Sk. Anwar Ali  ... for the Petitioner  Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay  Mr. Priyabrata Batabyal  ... for the State  Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken  on record.

Mr. Anwar Ali, learned advocate for the  petitioner, submits that the land in question is  purchased by the petitioner from the erstwhile owner  by virtue of a registered Deed of Conveyance executed  in his favour on 25th of April, 1997.
However, without  any acquisition been made in respect of the land in  question, the Health Department is utilising the said  land.
Till date, no compensation has been paid to the  petitioner in respect of the land in question.
